resharper_csharp_indent_invocation_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent method calls' parenthesis. Observed and not implemented: the four values put a wrapped call's closing ) and its contents at different levels. The closing delimiter's indent belongs to the wrapping pass.

Typeone of inside, outside, outside_and_inside, none
Defaultinside
Default known fromthe Rider export, which is Rider's default for most keys and the author's choice for the rest, with nothing distinguishing the two
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet

resharper_csharp_indent_method_decl_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent method declarations' parenthesis. Observed and not implemented, for the same reason as indent_invocation_pars: none puts the parameters at the declaration's own level and outside moves the closing ) in one level.

Typeone of inside, outside, outside_and_inside, none

resharper_csharp_indent_primary_constructor_decl_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent primary constructor declarations' parenthesis. Inert under this configuration: it moves the closing ) only when that ) is on a line of its own, and this export sets wrap_before_primary_constructor_declaration_rpar = false. Measured — with both flipped the oracle indents the ) by one level.

Typeone of inside, outside, outside_and_inside, none
